sources.name: 3D BAG

tilePatternGpkg.foundIn: the 3dbag.nl viewer bundle js/app.90a1aa28.js, and the WFS tiles layer property gpkg_download

api.note: NOT used: per-tile GeoPackage is chosen over API paging (plan A5 preference)

sources.creditRules: give credit; link to the copyright page in digital media; indicate if you made changes; on a browsable map the credit appears in the bottom right corner

upstreamLicences.AHN5 (2023-2025): CC BY 4.0 (Het Waterschapshuis), per metadata.json lineage. NOTE: READINESS.md says AHN is CC0; the AHN5 point cloud that 3D BAG heights mostly come from is listed here as CC BY 4.0. 3D BAG's own credit chain already carries it, but Task A11 must decide whether an AHN credit line is owed. The exact AHN5 credit wording was NOT found on an official AHN page.

tilesIntersectingArea.method: WFS BAG3D:tiles, bbox = area + 50 m in EPSG:28992

used.rule: centroid inside the 2.8 km square; height = lod12_2d b3_h_70p minus pand b3_h_maaiveld (NAP); multi-part buildings one row per part; sha256 of each .gpkg.gz verified against the WFS tile index
used.rdToWgs84: pyproj default operation "Inverse of RD New + Amersfoort to WGS 84 (4)", stated accuracy 1 m; "(3)" differs by 5 mm at the centre; no grid-based RDNAPTRANS2018 operation is offered by the local PROJ 9.8.1 database even with the network enabled
used.downloadNote: the server sets Content-Encoding: gzip on the .gz files; requests must read raw bytes (decode_content=False) or the published sha256 never matches

sources.role: terrain DTM and DSM (Task A6; DSM for guard G5)
sources.name: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN) WCS, PDOK / Rijkswaterstaat
sources.nativeCrs: EPSG:28992 (RD New), 0.5 m, values in metres above NAP
sources.epoch: The service abstract says: 'Het huidige AHN is versie 4. Deze versie is ingewonnen over de jaren 2020, 2021 en 2022.' So the WCS serves AHN4 (2020-2022), NOT AHN5 (2023). 3D BAG heights for this area come mostly from AHN5 (2023). Guard G5 therefore compares across a 1-3 year vintage gap.
sources.getCoverageSyntax: service=WCS&version=2.0.1&request=GetCoverage&coverageId=<id>&format=image/tiff&subset=x(minx,maxx)&subset=y(miny,maxy)  (coordinates in EPSG:28992; larger than 4000 px per side returns HTTP 400 'Raster size out of range ... MAXSIZE=4000')
sources.dtmDefinition: ground-classified points resampled by squared IDW; DSM = all points except water
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 (for the AHN4 coverage served here)

used.extentRD: 119329.0 484883.0 .. 122255.0 487822.0 (+50 m pad, snapped outward to the 0.5 m lattice)

sources.name: Beck et al. (2023) 1 km Koppen-Geiger maps 1901-2099, Scientific Data 10, 724
sources.result: class 15 = Cfb (Temperate, no dry season, warm summer) at the area centre and at both north-east and south-west corners of the 2.8 km square
sources.cite: Beck, H. E., McVicar, T. R., Vergopolan, N., Berg, A., Lutsko, N. J., Dufour, A., Zeng, Z., Jiang, X., van Dijk, A. I. J. M., Miralles, D. G. (2023) Scientific Data 10, 724

sources.name: KNMI, Schiphol (station 240), langjarige gemiddelden, tijdvak 1991-2020
sources.readingNote: Read from the PDF text layer with pdftotext -layout; columns are gemiddeld / gemiddeld minimum / gemiddeld maximum. Schiphol is about 8.5 km from the area (READINESS.md).
sources.licence: per https://www.knmi.nl/copyright (site default CC0 with credit 'bron: KNMI' and a statement that KNMI is not involved in derivative work, as summarised in READINESS.md; the copyright page itself was re-requested here (HTTP 200) but its wording was not re-read in this task)
